encode_keypoints_for_pose_lifting: encode 2D keypoints and 3D lifting targets into normalized coordinates for pose lifting
decode_lifted_keypoints: decode normalized 3D keypoint coordinates back to global space using the target root
initialize_pose_lifting_codec: initialize an ImagePoseLifting codec with root index and optional normalization statistics
review_ImagePoseLifting_encode: review the ImagePoseLifting encode method that zero-centers targets around a root keypoint
review_ImagePoseLifting_decode: review the ImagePoseLifting decode method that denormalizes and reinserts the root keypoint
